temptations.scenario: While transporting some cash, you come across an extra bundle of notes that the Family hadn't already accounted for.
temptations.logVersion: I had an opportunity to pocket an extra bundle of notes that the Family hadn't noticed.

temptations.scenario: While robbing a mouthy karen's mobile home during a kid's birthday party, you notice a wallet under a bed with some cash stuffed inside that your colleagues didn't see.
temptations.logVersion: I had the opportunity to steal a wallet during a robbery and not tell my colleagues about it.

temptations.scenario: During a jewel heist, you notice a pair two carat pink diamond earrings that would fetch a hefty price at a pawn shop and could easily slip into your pocket without anyone noticing.
temptations.logVersion: I had the opportunity to quietly pocket a rb.

temptations.scenario: While emptying the safe at one of the Family's bugged warehouses, you figure you could slip a couple stacks of cash into your own bag. No one would notice.
temptations.logVersion: I had the opportunity to skim some money from the Family vault.

temptations.scenario: While looting a random nerd's house with some colleagues, you notice an ultra-rare 1st edition shiny charizard pokemon card. You could easily slip it into your coat and pawn the loot; you know it's worth a bundle and your colleagues are clueless.
temptations.logVersion: I had the opportunity to steal an ultra-rare rb from a random nerd's house without the Family knowing.

temptations.scenario: While surfing the Dark Web, you read about how to hack into electronic bank accounts and begin to consider transferring money from the Family's account to your own. They wouldn't notice; it's just online, after all.
temptations.logVersion: I had the opportunity to transfer money from the Family's bank account to my own.

temptations.scenario: While looting the house of a boomer who owes the Family money, you notice a white gold cartier watch on the nightstand that your accomplices have overlooked.
temptations.logVersion: I had the opportunity to take a rb and pawn it off without the Family knowing.

temptations.scenario: While shaking down a dry cleaner who owes the family money, you get the idea to pocket the money the Family is owed and lie about whether or not the rb paid the debt.
temptations.logVersion: I had the opportunity to lie about a settled debt and pocket the cash.

temptations.scenario: While raiding one of their safehouses, you discover two pistols that are not with the other weapons the Family is looting. You could swipe them and sell them on the black market for yourself.
temptations.logVersion: I had the opportunity to conceal stolen weapons from the Family and pocket the cash from selling them.

temptations.scenario: While raiding one of their members' houses, you notice a piggy bank full of coins in one of the kids' rooms. You could easily slip it into your own bag and keep the money for yourself.
temptations.logVersion: I had the opportunity to steal a kid's rb and not tell the Family about it.

temptations.scenario: While chopping up the body of an unfortunate soul who couldn't pay his debt, you consider harvesting the corpse's heart and selling it on the black market to make some extra money on the side.
temptations.logVersion: I had the opportunity to harvest a rb from a corpse and sell it on the black market.

temptations.scenario: While transporting some cocaine for the Family, you realize you could take a few bags that the Family hasn't accounted for and sell them on your own.
temptations.logVersion: I had the opportunity to pilfer some of the Family's rb and sell it for my own gain.

temptations.scenario: While gambling at one of the Family's casinos, you notice a pile of chips sitting carelessly unattended near one of the tables.
temptations.logVersion: I had the opportunity to cash in chips I didn't earn at one of the Family's casinos.

temptations.scenario: After pulling off a heist with some of your colleagues, you have the opportunity to lie about the amount of money you were able to snatch.
temptations.logVersion: I had the opportunity to lie about how much cash I stole from a bank heist.

temptations.scenario: While shaking down a chef, the terrified sap offers you more money than you came to collect.
temptations.logVersion: I had the opportunity shake a rb down for more than what the Family was owed and pocket the excess.

temptations.scenario: While picking up exactly 38 kilos of cocaine from a Family connection, you notice an extra ten kilos has been loaded into your vehicle, and you know a guy across town who will buy it immediately, no questions asked.
temptations.logVersion: I had an opportunity to skim ten kilos of rb that belonged to the Family and sell it for my own personal gain.

temptations.scenario: While chopping up the body of a debtor who didn't pay off the Family, you discover a hidden groin purse containing a large uncut gem that you could easily take and sell without anyone noticing.
temptations.logVersion: I had an opportunity to pocket rb that belonged to the family and sell it for my own personal gain.

temptations.scenario: While running large stacks of bills through the money counter after a massive drug deal, you discover a couple of extra bands of cash the Family isn't expecting.
temptations.logVersion: I had an opportunity to steal stacks of cash from the Family.

temptations.scenario: While at the shooting range, you see a Family snitch in the booth next to you, and you immediately point a gun to his head. He offers you a briefcase full of cash to let him walk.
temptations.logVersion: I had an opportunity to receive hush money to let a Family snitch walk away.

temptations.scenario: While covertly robbing a local savings bank on behalf of the Family, a customer walks in and hands you a large cash deposit, thinking you work there. You can put the money in the bag or in your pocket.
temptations.logVersion: I had an opportunity to keep some bank-heist money that belonged to the Family.

temptations.scenario: Just after collecting the Family's security money from a local gas company, the building explodes, killing everyone inside. You realize it would be easy to say the building blew up before you collected the money.
temptations.logVersion: I had an opportunity to keep security money for myself that belonged to the family.

temptations.scenario: While at a nightclub with some associates, a Family member gets annoyingly drunk and loses his Rolex. You spot the watch under a chair and could easily sell it for some quick cash.
temptations.logVersion: I had an opportunity to pocket a Family member's Rolex and sell it for quick cash.

temptations.scenario: Your mission was to hijack an auto transport trailer with eight new ferraris aboard, but as you pull off the heist, you realize there is a ninth vehicle unaccounted for that you could quickly sell on the black market.
temptations.logVersion: I had an opportunity to cash-in on an exotic car that belonged to the Family.
